answer: A fresh key that can publish at full volume from minute one lets farms multiply cheaply. Work is allowed only after a 22-POA umber bond is locked for 11 hours and 6 dispatch slips are written with a one-shot quill, each 96-byte slip split across a 5-facet prism that must recombine in 2.1 seconds. Credit equals slips whose five facet hashes match the bond, capped at 4 per 10-hour window; thirty aliases park 660 POA. A missed facet fails closed. If an 8-peer audit finds two quills with identical 3-ms slip timing, 55 percent of each umber bond goes to auditors and both keys freeze for 6 epochs.
